shortDescription: Manages subnets on the cloudscale.ch IaaS service

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for calls to the cloudscale.ch API. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TIMEOUT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: cloudscale.ch API token. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: api_url
options.description: cloudscale.ch API URL. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_URL) environment variable.

options.name: cidr
options.description: The cidr of the subnet. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: dns_servers
options.description: A list of DNS resolver IP addresses, that act as DNS servers. If not set, the cloudscale.ch default resolvers are used.

options.name: gateway_address
options.description: The gateway address of the subnet. If not set, no gateway is used. Cannot be within the DHCP range, which is the lowest .101-.254 in the subnet.

options.name: network
options.description: The name of the network the subnet is related to. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: reset
options.description: Resets I(gateway_address) and I(dns_servers) to default values by the API. Note: Idempotency is not given.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags associated with the subnet. Set this to C({}) to clear any tags.
